app.title: Disk Clone
banner.notElevated: The application is not running as administrator/root: the disk list is limited and operations are blocked. Restart it as administrator.
banner.devSafe: Safe development mode: only USB, VHD and loop disks are allowed as destination.
backup.typeDiskHint: Bit-by-bit copy of the whole disk to another drive
backup.typeImageHint: Bit-by-bit copy of the whole disk into a compressed .img.zst file
backup.spaceHint: The final size is smaller thanks to compression, but the whole disk must fit.
backup.fat32Warning: The destination is FAT32: a file larger than 4 GiB cannot be saved.
confirm.title: Confirm operation
confirm.cloneWarning: ALL data on {disk} will be erased and replaced.
confirm.ack: I understand that the data on the destination drive will be lost
result.verifyOk: Verification OK: the copy is identical to the source.
notices.clone_offline: The written disk is offline: disconnect it before rebooting and do not bring it online on this PC (Windows would change its signature and the disk would no longer boot).
notices.dest_offline: The destination disk was taken offline for the copy and still is: disconnect and reconnect it (or bring it online in Disk Management) before using it again.
notices.gpt_backup_header: The destination is larger than the source: the backup GPT table is not at the end of the disk. Some tools will report it as damaged; fix it with gdisk or Disk Management.
errors.same_disk: Source and destination are the same disk.
errors.source_system: The system disk in use cannot be copied.
errors.dest_system: Writing to the system disk is not allowed.
errors.dest_too_small: The destination disk is smaller than the source.
errors.dev_safe_not_external: In safe mode the destination must be a USB, VHD or loop disk.
errors.dest_on_source: The image file cannot be saved on a partition of the source disk.
errors.image_on_dest: The image is on the destination drive: it would be overwritten while being read.
errors.insufficient_space: Not enough space: the destination must hold at least the size of the source disk.
errors.fat32_limit: The disk is larger than 4 GiB, the maximum file size on FAT32.
errors.disk_not_found: The disk is no longer present. Press Refresh.
errors.stat_failed: Cannot read the free space of the destination.
errors.prepare_failed: Cannot unmount or lock the disk volumes (is a program using them?).
errors.verify_mismatch: Verification FAILED: the copy differs from the source. The destination media may be faulty.
errors.finish_failed: Copy completed, but the system did not re-read the partition table: disconnect and reconnect the disk.
errors.image_corrupt: The image is damaged: the data does not match its checksum.
errors.image_incomplete: The image is incomplete (its creation was interrupted).
errors.not_diskclone_image: The file is not an image created by Disk Clone.
